subject: read.capthist error when including sessions without captures

messages.author: 3a5ecc9a7eeb64b1
messages.subject: read.capthist error when including sessions without captures
parts:
Hi all,

I am having a problem reading in a capture history file when I include sessions where there were no captures made but trapping took place. If I remove the "NONE" ids, then I can load the capture histories fine. If I am only loading in a capture history with one session where no captures occurred then it is fine, but not when I include sessions where we caught on 2 of the occasions but not the final one, or if I have two periods where we didnt trap anything on those capture sessions. 

The error I get is "Error in order(captTrap, abs(captures[validcapt, 3]), captID) : argument lengths differ" but I am having trouble seeing where this error is coming from 


I include two example dataframes with and without the "none" data. I am sure I am probably missing something obvious :)

The data is small rodent trapping, we use sherman traps but we do catch more than one individual at a time in the traps sometimes so I use trap type "multi". We trap monthly, for three nights each month, with a robust design. Our actual dataset is quite large, and we did have a period where we didnt trap any rodents. Therefore, retaining these periods of population collapse is of interest to us.

Any help is much appreciated

Thanks, Luci

code I am using to read in the data

datadir<-"data_directory"
xlsname <- paste0(datadir, '/ex_capt.xlsx')
CH <- read.capthist (xlsname, sheet = c("capt_det", "traps"), fmt = "trapID", skip = 1,
detector = "multi", noncapt = "NONE")

messages.author: e3e2b3d751efd4da
messages.subject: Re: read.capthist error when including sessions without captures
parts:
Hi Luci,

I am sure Murray or someone else will correct me if I am wrong, but I believe the noncapt=“NONE” argument operates at the level of session, not occasion?

So for example session TS_220 you’ve three records (one each of occasion 1, 2, and 3) and in session TS_229 you’ve one ’NONE’ record (for occasion 3) even though animals in that session were caught in occasions 1 and 2.

I've made a mock example in Sheet1 in the attach which imports fine for me, code copied below.

To specify you want three capture occasions, also remember the ’noccasions’ argument as well. 

HTH,

Jo
xlsname <- paste0(datadir, '/ex_capt.xlsx')

CH <- read.capthist (xlsname, sheet = c("Sheet1", "traps"), fmt = "trapID", skip = 1,
                     detector = "multi", noncapt = "NONE", noccasions=3)

messages.subject: Re: read.capthist error when including sessions without captures
parts:
Hi Joanne,

Thanks for your quick response. That indeed makes sense, removing those sessions gets rid of that error. However, using a larger dataset where I have a few missing sessions, I get the warning that there are duplicated or missing row names (I assume referring to the fact that NONE is used as the rownames), and factor covariates differ between sessions. I have tried to use the shareFactorLevels function to correct the factor level sharing but that falls down on the sessions where I have missing data because at those points there is no covariate dataframe, and these sessions are the ones causing the error. I have only one entry / occasion per trapsession that was missed (but including all three occasions throws the same error - I thought I would check that just in case).

I can see from looking into the code for shareFactorLevels and m.array that my errors are coming from the sessions where I didnt catch any animals. How do I correct this?

Thanks, Luci

parts:
Hi Luci,

Are you sure it is an error (i.e. hasn’t worked) or a warning (i.e., has worked but given a warning message?).

I have a bit of trouble understanding what you mean but I think the attached has multiple sessions that NONE were caught, and multiple sessions were animals were caught. When I import I get a warning message, but the importing has still worked:
> CH <- read.capthist (xlsname, sheet = c("Sheet1", "traps"), fmt = "trapID", skip = 1, detector = "multi", noncapt = "NONE", noccasions=3)

Session TS_278                                                                           
No live releases
Duplicated or missing row names (animal ID)
Session TS_280 
No live releases
Duplicated or missing row names (animal ID)
Warning message:
In verify.capthist(temp) :
  Levels of factor covariate(s) differ between sessions

You can plot e.g. 
plot(CH$TS_277)

But obviously can’t plot sessions TS_278 and TS_280 because they didn’t have any capture events. 

Perhaps I have misunderstood what you mean, if so, maybe send through a reproducible answer so I can follow.

HTH,

Jo

parts:
Hi,

I found this thread very helpful but am also running into similar problems.

I have a dataset with multiple sessions: some sessions with captures of just one sex and some sessions with no captures at all. I want to run a model with sex on sigma.

If I exclude the sessions with no captures then I can read in the data and use the shareFactorLevels function to ensure each session has two levels even if it only caught one sex. I can then run models with sex.

However, if I try and read in the data with sessions that have no captures at all and enter in dummy rows with NONE for those sessions and 0 for all other columns I get the same warnings as Luci but no errors. However, when I try and run models, even ones without sex I get this error:

Error in secr.fit(all, model = list(D ~ session, g0 ~ 1, sigma ~ 1), buffer = 1000,  : 
  'verify' found errors in 'capthist' argument

I also get this error if I delete the sex covariate and try and read it in with just missing sessions. When I read in the data I just get the following for the missing sessions but no errors.

No live releases
Duplicated or missing row names (animal ID)

If I delete the missing sessions it runs fine. Any idea what is going on?

Thanks,
Alex
